note: The bureau's own statements, on Credit and Data Bureau (SI) Ltd's site (cdb.com.sb, read 2026-10-31), and the Central Bank of Solomon Islands' notice on the Credit Reporting System (read 2026-10-31), which says the system is being established through the Credit & Data Bureau Solomon Islands under the Credit Reporting Regulations (2025). The bureau's FAQ: information stays on the bureau seven years and isn't deleted unless inaccurate; a payment amends the debt's balance (to zero) rather than removing it: written as keep 7, with no clears. Its services page: members generally load debts in default for more than 60 days: written as reported 61 days after the due date ('more than N days' is N+1; 'generally' is the bureau's word, a member may load later). The Credit Reporting Regulations 2025 themselves (L.N. 415 of 2025; s.25, retention of credit information) weren't read: the Central Bank's PDF links answer 404 and PacLII's copy (pacliirms.austlii.edu.au) answered 503; the bureau's FAQ isn't dated and may predate them.

sources.title: Credit and Data Bureau (SI) Ltd: FAQs
sources.said: How long does information stay on the Credit Bureau? Information stays on the Credit Bureau for a duration of seven years. The Credit Bureau does not delete any information unless it is inaccurate. If a payment is made towards a debt that is on your file, it will be amended to carry the balance or zero.

sources.title: Credit and Data Bureau (SI) Ltd: Services
sources.said: Members are able to load their defaulting debts on the CDB Database. A debt is in default when it is unpaid beyond the credit terms given. Generally members load debts which are in default for more than 60 days.

sources.title: Central Bank of Solomon Islands: Notice on the Credit Reporting System
sources.said: The Central Bank of Solomon Islands (CBSI) wishes to inform the public that a Credit Reporting System (CRS) is being established in Solomon Islands through the Credit & Data Bureau Solomon Islands (CDBSI) in accordance with the Credit Reporting Regulations.
